targets.expr: round(sum_over_time((increase(cvs_exc_per_service{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance", exception_name!~"NoneType|KeyboardInterrupt", service=~"Detection|Ctm|Gtm|DecisionEngine"}[1h]) and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) max_over_time(swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"}[1h]) and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))[$__range:1h])) > 0

panels.title: VideoStream Exceptions
Daily Trend: Avg VideoStream Exceptions per Pool
panels.description: Daily overall average of VideoStream exception counts per pool. Tracked separately from algo containers because volume differs by orders of magnitude.

targets.expr: sum((increase(cvs_exc_per_service{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance", exception_name!~"NoneType|KeyboardInterrupt", service="VideoStream"}[1d]) and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) max_over_time(swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"}[1d]) and on(pool_name, site_name, environment) (docker_version_tag == $cvs_version or docker_version_tag * (1 - ($cvs_version > bool 0)) > 0))) / scalar(count(count by (pool_name, site_name, environment) (max_over_time(swimmer_count{environment=~"$server", site_name=~"$site_name", pool_name=~"$pool_name", pool_state=~"$pool_state", group=~"$deploy_group", under_maintenance=~"$under_maintenance"}[1d:1h]))))
